name: MedAlign
description: MedAlign is a benchmark dataset of 983 natural language instructions for electronic health record data, curated by clinicians to evaluate LLMs on realistic healthcare instruction-following tasks with clinician-written reference responses.
reputation: A niche but credible clinician-curated benchmark that is cited for evaluating realistic healthcare instruction-following and EHR-grounded generation.
notes: Includes clinician rankings and longitudinal EHRs; highlights high error rates and context length impact on accuracy.
